name: Cooking Hub
description: Cooking Hub by Marvel Corp - what's for dinner, sorted. Recipes with step-by-step Cook Along, a Dinner Finder that works from what you have, your pantry with use-by reminders, a weekly meal plan with a grocery list, and your family's own cookbook - write Grandma's recipes down or keep a photo of her card. Two looks: a storybook kitchen or a classic recipe box. Data stays on your phone.
